description: Caring for one computer on which OATS agents run: take stock of it, keep it and its agent tooling current within clear limits, route requests to the right agent, and hand anything that needs a human (sudo, logins, purchases, outward acts) to the person as a request they see. Assigned to the steward and technician souls.

requires.why: read the deployments on this machine, their instances and readiness; spawn and retire technicians; raise attention for the person
mail and chat with agents, and with the person on a conversation they started
